bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll --format '{{.ID}}')
if [ "$cid" != "9ee9843ecb1e" ]; then printf 'POLLER_CHANGED\n'; exit 72; fi
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"),path=require("node:path"),crypto=require("node:crypto");const root="/opt/videobot";function hash(kind,b){return crypto.createHash("sha1").update(kind+" "+b.length+"\0").update(b).digest("hex")}function entry(p){let s=fs.lstatSync(p);if(s.isDirectory()){const list=fs.readdirSync(p,{withFileTypes:true});list.sort((a,b)=>Buffer.compare(Buffer.from(a.name+(a.isDirectory()?"/":"")),Buffer.from(b.name+(b.isDirectory()?"/":""))));const chunks=[];for(const item of list){const v=entry(path.join(p,item.name));chunks.push(Buffer.from(v.mode+" "+item.name+"\0"),Buffer.from(v.hash,"hex"))}return {mode:"40000",hash:hash("tree",Buffer.concat(chunks))}}if(s.isSymbolicLink())return {mode:"120000",hash:hash("blob",Buffer.from(fs.readlinkSync(p)))};if(!s.isFile())throw Error("UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE");return {mode:s.mode&0o111?"100755":"100644",hash:hash("blob",fs.readFileSync(p))}}for(const p of ["src","owner","sql","web","package.json","src/sales/pgListings.mjs"]){const v=entry(path.join(root,p));console.log(v.hash+" "+p)}'
